inline_text:
## Context

The charter positions the WG as a coordination forum, not a competing standards body. It calls for active coordination with OpenTelemetry GenAI, OWASP AOS, W3C Trace Context, MCP, AGNTCY, Monocle, and other AAIF working groups.

## Scope

Create a liaison roster and cross-WG intake tracker that records:

- external groups or standards bodies the WG should track
- internal AAIF WGs with observability-related overlap
- the central AAIF Taxonomy/Landscape working group as a regular coordination point
- nominated or acting liaisons
- recurring update cadence, where known
- open asks from other groups
- outbound questions or proposals from this WG

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A liaison roster or tracker exists in the repository.
- [ ] The tracker includes the initial external groups named in the charter.
- [ ] The tracker includes internal AAIF WGs with known observability overlap.
- [ ] The tracker includes the central AAIF Taxonomy/Landscape working group and expected coordination cadence.
- [ ] Each entry has an owner or is explicitly marked as needing an owner.
- [ ] The tracker includes a place for inbound asks and outbound follow-ups.
- [ ] The README or working methods document links to the tracker.

## Notes

This should be a lightweight coordination artifact. It should help avoid duplicate standards work and make cross-WG requests visible.
